chunks: Abān narrated from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man pledged two bracelets with another man, and one of them was destroyed.
He said: "He may reclaim his right from what remains."

key_terms.بِحَقِّهِ: with his due right or claim
key_terms.فِيمَا بَقِيَ: from what remains of the pledged property

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one item of pledged collateral is destroyed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning collateral in a pledge. If part of the pledged property is destroyed, the creditor may recover his due from the portion that remains.
